source.name: Aerith Weekly Information about Bright Comets
source.notes: Normalized source snapshot for AstroGuide comet metadata review. Brightness estimates may be used to patch hosted comet magnitudes. Approved small image copies must be cached through AstroGuide metadata; app clients must not hotlink Aerith images.
